params.recipient: The address to receive the unclaimed balance.
params.token: The token whose airdrop to claim.

amountAvailableToClaim(address,address,u.details: Assumes the caller has a valid Merkle proof for `allocatedAmount`.

claim(address,address,uint256,bytes32[]).details: Verifies a Merkle proof of (`recipient`, `allocatedAmount`) against the airdrop's root.

params.recipient: The recipient address (also the leaf identity).
params.token: The token whose airdrop to claim.

params.extensionIndex: Index of this extension in the deployment config.
params.extensionSupply: Token amount allocated to this airdrop.

params.token: The token whose airdrop to update.
The token whose airdrop merkle root to update.

CLAIM_EXPIRATION_INTERVAL().notice: Window after vesting ends during which the admin can sweep unclaimed (14 days).

MIN_LOCKUP_DURATION().notice: Minimum lockup duration before claims can begin. Set to 0 so         deployers who have verified the merkle root off-chain (e.g.         via the launcher UI's allowlist preview) can open claims in         the next block. The root still freezes after the first claim,         so a wrong root is unrecoverable — verify before deploying.

ZERO_CLAIM_OVERWRITE_INTERVAL().notice: After the lockup, time the admin may overwrite the merkle root if no claims have occurred.

adminClaim(address,address).notice: Sweeps unclaimed tokens to a recipient after the claim expiration interval. Admin only.

amountAvailableToClaim(address,address,u.notice: Returns the amount currently claimable for a recipient given their allocated amount.

claim(address,address,uint256,bytes32[]).notice: Claims the currently vested portion of `recipient`'s airdrop allocation.

receiveTokens(((address,string,string,by.notice: Called by the factory to escrow the airdrop allocation.

updateAdmin(address,address).notice: Transfers admin rights for a token's airdrop. Current admin only.

updateMerkleRoot(address,bytes32).notice: Updates the merkle root if it is currently zero, or if the         `ZERO_CLAIM_OVERWRITE_INTERVAL` has passed without any claims. Admin only.
